query:
SELECT 
  sp.id as seller_profile_id,
  sp.userId,
  sp.displayName,
  sp.isActive,
  sp.stripeConnectStatus,
  mo.id as order_id,
  mo.orderNo,
  mo.sellerId as order_seller_id,
  mo.orderStatus,
  mo.sellerType
FROM sellerProfiles sp
LEFT JOIN marketplaceOrders mo ON mo.sellerId = sp.id
WHERE mo.orderStatus IN ('processing', 'payment_received', 'paid_held')
LIMIT 20;
